component.name: paint.js
component.summary: An open source general-purpose raster graphics editor program

description.p: An open source general-purpose raster graphics editor program. It is inspired by the classic Paint.NET interface and provides a familiar desktop workspace on Linux and macOS.

Work with multiple documents and layers, zoom and pan around the canvas, and use selection, movement, drawing, color, and image-adjustment tools. A complete undo and redo history lets you experiment without losing earlier work.
The editor supports common raster formats as well as layered Paint.NET documents. paint.js is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by dotPDN LLC or Paint.NET.
